claims.evidence: Witness photos identify the lens as Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G, but do not show where it was used or its origin.
Photos show the lens externally, but do not clearly confirm absence of scratches, fungus, haze, oil on glass, internal dust, or internal optics condition.

risks.risk: Optics may have haze, fungus, scratches, or oil on the glass that isn’t clearly visible in the provided close-ups.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video through the front and rear glass under bright light (including angled reflections) plus a wipe-test/inspection shot showing no haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used lens with unknown optical condition (worst-case: possible haze/fungus/scratches).

risks.risk: Autofocus and aperture may be faulty or inconsistent (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: A short video of autofocus locking on a nearby object and a shot showing aperture changes/exposure behavior on a compatible Nikon body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: AF/aperture issues).

risks.risk: Missing front/rear caps and/or hood (not clearly shown) can reduce value and increase risk of further damage.
risks.proof: A photo showing the lens with all accessories laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing caps/hood if not shown.

risks.risk: Lens mount condition (threads/contacts) may be worn or damaged, causing poor fit or electrical contact issues.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the mount contacts/threads from straight-on and at an angle to check wear and any wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mount condition unknown (worst-case: mount wear).

risks.risk: Internal dust or debris may be present (not verifiable from the photos).
risks.proof: A photo of the rear element at an angle with strong backlight to reveal internal dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as internal condition unknown (worst-case: noticeable dust).

proof_requests: Show whether front cap, rear cap, and any hood are included (one photo with accessories laid out).
Provide clear angled photos of both front and rear glass under bright light to check for fungus/haze/scratches/oil.
Test and record a short video of autofocus locking and aperture/exposure behavior on a Nikon body.
Take a straight-on close-up of the lens mount contacts/threads to confirm no damage or heavy wear.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition while treating the seller’s 'like new/clean' statement as not verifiable from the photos.
